links.surface: أَبُو الْحُسَيْنِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ النَّاقِدُ

notes: «بِإِسْنَادِهِ» after Ahmad refers to an isnad not written here (no previous report is supplied), so it is written in place as a back_reference
«قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ» : Umar ibn Sa'd is the next link; «قَالَ لَمَّا قُتِلَ الْحُسَيْنُ» is Zuhri's own words, so Zuhri is the last link; the Imam Husayn is in the saying, not a link

levels.surface: أبو الحسين أحمد بن عبد الله بن علي الناقد

notes: «بإسناده» sits mid-chain after the first teacher and points to an isnad that is not in this text or its context (no previous report supplied); kept as a back_reference, not filled.
